pulls.title: Actor Chain Profile Support
pulls.author: mcguinness
pulls.body:
I think there in an opportunity to address a large interop gap with this spec with actor chains

See https://notes.karlmcguinness.com/notes/standardize-act-across-assertion-grants-and-jwt-access-tokens/ for description of the problem.

I don't think optimizing for a single-hop delegation is the right play for a new spec like this.  Addressing the large gap with delegation chains would drive urgency for adoption as folks don't have prior art.  

I don't expect this PR to be merged as-is, but rather start a discussion with something concrete that we can react to.   Happy to discuss more if you are interested.
